description: Website uptime and change check: is this URL up right now, and has the page changed? Fetches the URL and returns the HTTP status, Last-Modified and ETag headers, a SHA-256 fingerprint of the content, and whether it changed versus a hash you pass in. Use it to check a site is live, detect stale data, monitor a page for changes, or decide whether to invalidate a cache before your agent acts on what it says. Returns a signed attestation. Free tier is unsigned and rate-limited. For a cryptographically signed attestation with no daily limit ($0.02 USDC), add an x402 payment header to THIS SAME tool call (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for v2, X-PAYMENT for v1) or POST /verify/freshness over HTTP. Same price on either transport.

prior_hash.description: Optional prior SHA-256 hex to compare against
